column2: one of the seven $$封印の鎖$$s that support this $$世界$$...
How long must I continue the $$罪$$ of forgiving you people?!
We've even made our $$教皇$$ worry. I am truly sorry, ma'am.
I was busy assessing the $$戦力$$ of that so-called $$大邪神$$ armor,
so I let them run loose a little too long!
And what of those people I ordered, to counter the $$大邪神$$'s power?
We've already handpicked people whose passions are second to none in this $$世界$$!
Now that there are already four enemies wearing armor...
I fear that as things stand, we may be one or two people short in $$戦力$$...
There is not a moment to lose!
If we leave the revival of further $$邪神$$s unchecked, unprecedented disaster will surely strike this entire $$世界$$!
$$ルカ$$, at this point, we must ask you yourself to get to work!
